pm_kisan.summary: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year to eligible farmer families, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000. Needs Aadhaar-linked bank account and e-KYC.

pmfby.summary: Crop insurance. Farmer premium is at most 2% (kharif food/oilseed crops), 1.5% (rabi food/oilseed crops) and 5% (commercial/horticultural crops); the rest is paid by the government. Report crop loss within 72 hours to the insurer, the bank or the Crop Insurance app.

kcc_loan.summary: Kisan Credit Card gives short-term farm credit from banks at subsidised interest with a prompt-repayment incentive. Apply at your bank branch or cooperative society with land papers.

soil_health_card.summary: Free card with soil test results and fertilizer advice for your field, renewed every two years. Ask the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture office.

kisan_call_centre.summary: Free helpline where agriculture experts answer farmers' questions in local languages.
